Shows coast of Venezuela in the region of Araya. Depths shown by soundings. Oriented with north toward the lower left. Watermark: J. Honig & Zoonen. Pen-and-ink and watercolor. Mounted on cloth backing. Includes note and view. Maggs number annotated in pencil in lower right corner: 36.
